In this video, I break down the 5 types of Survival Food I think every new prepper should focus on first when building an emergency food system for power outages, disasters, emergencies, and long-term grid-down situations.

We'll look at:
Foundation foods
Canned foods
Canned meats
No-cook / ready-to-eat foods

snippet.title: Take 15 meals with me #cooking #food
snippet.description:
570 Calories | 60g Protein | 41g Carbs | 18g Fat

Creamy Jalapeño Bacon Cheeseburger Penne

Makes 15 Meal Prep Containers

Shopping Haul List

Meat

* 6 lb (2,722g) 96/4 ground beef
* 20 slices Godshall’s Beef Bacon

Pasta and Sauce

* 2 boxes Mueller’s 18g Protein Penne
* 1 jar Botticelli Alla Vodka Sauce — 6 servings

Cheese

* 15 slices reduced-fat, not-smoked provolone cheese

Produce

* 12 oz (340g) red onions
* 1 12-oz jar sliced jalapeños

Instructions

1. Cook the Beef

Place all 6 pounds of 96/4 ground beef into one large pan.

Cook the beef untouched for 2½ minutes on the first side.

Flip the beef, then add:

* 16g garlic powder
* 16g onion powder
* 8g salt
* 6g black pepper

Break everything apart and continue cooking until the beef is completely browned.

2. Cook the Pasta

Boil both boxes of Mueller’s Protein Penne according to the package instructions.

Drain the cooked pasta and set it aside.

3. Cook the Beef Bacon and Onions

Thinly chop:

* 20 slices Godshall’s Beef Bacon
* 12 oz red onions

Add the chopped beef bacon and onions to a pan.

Cook everything together until the beef bacon and onions are browned.

4. Add the Jalapeños

Drain approximately three-fourths of the juice from the jalapeño jar.

Add the jalapeños and remaining juice to the beef bacon and onions.

Cook everything together for another 1–2 minutes.

5. Combine Everything

Add the following to one large bowl:

* Cooked ground beef
* Cooked protein penne
* Beef bacon and onion mixture
* Jalapeños
* Botticelli Alla Vodka Sauce

Mix everything together until evenly combined.

Divide everything evenly between 15 meal-prep containers.

Top each container with one slice of reduced-fat provolone cheese.

Storage and Reheating

These microwave times are specifically for Cooking for Gains meal-prep containers:

* From the refrigerator: Microwave for 2–3 minutes.
* From the freezer: Microwave for 5 minutes and 30 seconds.

Microwave times may vary when using containers from another company.

snippet.title: 11 Things That Still Work After an EMP (Most People Will Learn Too Late)
snippet.description:
📩 FREE DOWNLOAD → The 50 Dollar Food Plan (build 90 days of shelf-stable food for your family for about $50): https://zachofalltrades.io/freeplan/


There is a specific mental picture that most American families have of an EMP event, and almost all of it comes from fiction. 

Every electronic device dies at the same moment. 

Every car stops on the highway. Every phone goes dark. The grid comes down and stays down. 

Civilization reverts overnight to some 19th-century state.

That version is dramatic and it sells novels. It is not what the actual physics or the actual engineering research suggests would happen.

The real picture is genuinely different. In a serious EMP event, whether from a high-altitude nuclear detonation or from a solar coronal mass ejection like the 1859 Carrington Event, the primary damage would be to the electrical grid — particularly to the large transformers that step voltage up and down along transmission lines. Those transformers are custom-built, take a year or more to manufacture, and are largely produced overseas. 

That is the real infrastructure vulnerability, and if a serious event hit, the recovery timeline for the worst-affected regions could stretch to months or even years.

But — and this is the part almost no fictional treatment gets right — a great many things would still work.

The families that will do best in an actual EMP scenario are the ones who understand this distinction now, and who have quietly built up capabilities in the categories that would still work. 

The families that will struggle are the ones who prepared for the fictional version, expensive tactical gear, dramatic collapse scenarios, isolation strategies, while missing the specific practical categories that would actually matter.

Most people will learn this too late. This video is so you do not.


This is calm, grounded, research-informed preparedness for a topic that has been dramatized so heavily in popular culture that clear thinking about it has become genuinely rare. 

No doom. No hype. No fictional grid-down-forever framing. 

Just the honest engineering picture of what would actually happen — and the specific practical steps that produce real resilience against this scenario and every other extended grid disruption.

If this video was useful to you, the simplest way to help is to hit subscribe and share it with one person who has been thinking about EMP preparedness through the fictional lens rather than the actual engineering. They probably need this reframe more than they realize.

ভূমিকম্পের ঝুঁকিতে থাকা বাংলাদেশে যে-কোনো সময় ঘটতে পারে বড় ধরনের বিপর্যয়। ভূমিকম্প কখন হবে তা আগে থেকে জানা সম্ভব নয়, কিন্তু সঠিক প্রস্তুতি ও সচেতনতা থাকলে ক্ষয়ক্ষতি এবং প্রাণহানি অনেকাংশে কমানো সম্ভব। 

আজকের এই বিশেষ ইনফোগ্রাফিক ভিডিওতে আমরা বলেছি ভূমিকম্পের আগের প্রস্তুতি, ভূমিকম্প চলাকালীন করণীয় ও বর্জনীয় এবং ভূমিকম্পের পরের প্রয়োজনীয় সতর্কতা সম্পর্কে। Emergency Kit তৈরি থেকে শুরু করে ভূমিকম্পে সুরক্ষিত থাকার গোল্ডেন রুল (Drop, Cover and Hold On) জানবেন সবই। 

ভিডিওটি শেষ পর্যন্ত দেখুন, বিশেষ করে শেষের জীবনের সুরক্ষায় অত্যন্ত জরুরি টিপসটি মিস করবেন না!

ভিডিওটি আপনার পরিবার ও বন্ধুদের সাথে শেয়ার করে সচেতনতা বাড়াতে সাহায্য করুন। একটি তথ্য হয়তো কোনো একদিন একটি জীবন বাঁচাতে পারে।

🔔 নতুন ভিডিও পেতে চ্যানেলটি সাবস্ক্রাইব করুন এবং বেল আইকন চাপুন।

snippet.description:
Power Grid FAILURE - 8 Life-Saving Supplies You Must Stockpile NOW (2025 Guide)




When the power grid goes down for weeks or months, will you survive or become another statistic? This comprehensive grid-down survival guide reveals the 8 critical supplies you absolutely need to survive 90 days without electricity, running water, or modern conveniences. Whether you're facing a natural disaster, cyberattack, EMP strike, or total infrastructure collapse, this video covers everything from long-term food storage and water purification to solar power solutions, emergency lighting, medical supplies, and cold weather survival gear. Learn exactly what to stockpile, how much you need, and the specific brands and products that actual preppers rely on when SHTF.

Most people are completely unprepared for extended power outages and make critical mistakes that put their families at risk. This ultimate preparedness guide walks you through building a complete 90-day survival kit on any budget, with actionable steps you can start implementing today. Discover the best freeze-dried meals, water storage solutions, solar generators, portable power banks, emergency medical supplies, and manual tools that work when technology fails. We cover food storage techniques that extend shelf life for decades, water purification methods that remove 99.99% of contaminants, and shelter strategies that prevent hypothermia when heating systems fail.

Don't wait until empty store shelves and panic buying make preparation impossible. This video provides the complete roadmap for grid-down preparedness, including storage tips, budget-friendly alternatives, and the psychological strategies that separate survivors from victims. Whether you're a beginner prepper or experienced survivalist, you'll find essential information about emergency food supplies, off-grid power generation, sanitation without plumbing, first aid for grid-down scenarios, and the critical supplies most people forget. Subscribe to Crisis Horizon for more life-saving preparedness content and start building your survival kit today—your family's safety depends on it.

snippet.title: POV: how we meal prep for our daughters as high school athletes #mealprep #femaleathletes
snippet.description:
Apparently most of you didn’t know we have daughters!  Not only do we have daughters, we have THREE, including twins!

For years we’ve said we’re “meal prepping for our high school athletes,” but because our boys loved popping in and out of our videos, everyone assumed we meant boys. Now both boys are in college and we’re officially cooking for the girls!

One is a rower, one is a swimmer, and they’re having a lot of fun steering the meal-prep ship. The boys were VERY steak-and-potatoes heavy 😂 The girls love that too, but they’re bringing lots of fresh ideas to the menu.

Here’s what they picked this week! Meal prepping for our kids is easy thanks to @HexClad We’d love to hear what you think of the menu and send any requests our way!

MEAL PREP FOR THE WEEK  Breakfasts + lunches/dinners all done!

HOMEMADE GRANOLA
3 cups rolled oats
½ cup shredded coconut
⅓ cup toasted pumpkin seeds
2 Tbsp chia seeds
½ cup chopped pecans
½ cup maple syrup
½ cup melted coconut oil
½ cup dried cranberries

Mix everything except cranberries. Spread on a sheet pan + bake at 325°F for 30–40 min, stirring every 10 min, until golden. Cool completely + mix in cranberries. Serve with Greek yogurt + raspberries.

STRAWBERRY CHIA PUDDING
½ cup chia seeds
2 cups coconut milk
1 cup Greek yogurt
1 lb strawberries, puréed
2 Tbsp maple syrup
1 tsp vanilla

Mix well, divide into jars + refrigerate overnight.

STEAK + SWEET POTATO BOWLS
NY strip steaks
Sweet potatoes, halved
Broccoli
Olive oil, salt, pepper + garlic powder
Maple syrup
Tomato + cucumber + red onion

Roast broccoli with olive oil, salt, pepper + garlic powder at 400°F until browned. Roast sweet potatoes cut-side down with olive oil + a drizzle of maple syrup until tender.

Bring steaks to room temp, season generously with salt + pepper and sear in a hot skillet with olive oil. Add butter, garlic + rosemary and baste until cooked to your liking. Rest + slice.

Fill bowls with ½ sweet potato, broccoli + steak. Top with chopped tomato, cucumber + red onion seasoned with salt + pepper.

VIETNAMESE LEMONGRASS CHICKEN BOWLS

6 boneless chicken thighs

MARINADE:
2 Tbsp minced lemongrass
2 Tbsp minced shallot
6 garlic cloves
1½ tsp grated ginger
3 Tbsp oyster sauce
1½ Tbsp soy sauce
1 Tbsp fish sauce
1½ Tbsp honey
1½ Tbsp brown sugar
1½ Tbsp neutral oil

Marinate chicken at least 1 hour. Grill or sear 5–6 min/side until caramelized + cooked through. Rest + slice.

NUOC CHAM:
¼ cup warm water
2½ Tbsp sugar
2 Tbsp fish sauce
2 Tbsp lime juice
3 garlic cloves, minced
2 bird’s eye chilies, minced

Mix to combine.

Cook vermicelli noodles according to package directions. Assemble with noodles, chicken, shredded carrots + sliced cucumber. Spoon nuoc cham over the top.
